main_text.head: CONCORDANTIA.
Discordantium sectariorum.
main_text.p: FRidericus Staphylus in sua apologia (ut refert Prateolus in elencho alphabetico lib. 17. titulo Sectarij) scribit: omnes sectarios unanimi consensu quatuor articulos, praeter illos jam pridem perpetua dissensione intellectuq; contrario penitus convulserunt, retinere.

Planè angelicam nobis reliquit Tertullianus patientiæ ideam. Ideam dico, quia vix cadunt in hominem quamdiu hoc corporis ergastulum circumfert, quæ de patientia scripsit lib. de patient. pag. 16. Dicit eam habere vultum tranquillum & placidum, frontem puram, nulla mæroris aut iræ rugositate contractam. Divinus planè sit homo qui Jesuitarum libros & imprimis quoque

page.notes: The initial F is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "Ridericus". Catchword "que" appears at the lower right below the last line and is given here as the closing word of the text. Some letters in the italic lines are worn; readings such as "intellectuq;" follow the scan.
